english.title: Charge employee for something provided to meet relevant health / safety statutory requirement

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Health and Safety at work etc Act 1974

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an employer,

(A)_[levied]_
(B)_[permitted a levy on]_

**(..SPECIFY PERSON LEVIED..), an employee of yours, a charge in respect of **(..SPECIFY THING FOR WHICH CHARGE LEVIED..), it having been done or provided in pursuance of a specific requirement of a relevant statutory provision, namely **(..SPECIFY REQUIREMENT AND PROVISION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 9 and 33(1)(b) of, and Schedule 3A to, the Health and Safety at Work etc Act 1974.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes: Proceedings for an offence shall not, in England and Wales, be instituted except by an inspector or the Environment Agency or by or with the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions, see section 38 of the Health and Safety at Work etc Act 1974.
